recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-6045 unless a future work group decision changes the _sort guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-6045 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked the FHIR-core search page to clarify whether sorting is case-sensitive and directed language that sorting on string search parameters SHOULD be case-insensitive, with accent handling ignored or sorted by realm convention and sorting consistency treated as less essential than filtering.
initial_application: Commit 55a96928e15258ba3427937e83f70d6de7f82edc (#6045 - clarify string sorting) added the requested bullet to source/search.html on 2015-06-20, matching the Jira comment that SVN revision 5526 applied the change. Later commit 812cb4fdfe6996039a12822d5de369096950b3d3 (#9558 - change the way sort parameter works) reworked the _sort section but retained and reflowed the FHIR-6045 wording.
additional_context: The current combined branch still has the guidance in source/search.html in the Sorting (_sort) section. Jira searches for sort/case/accent wording found FHIR-6045 as the only matching FHIR-core issue. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community record; Zulip phrase hits concerned unrelated terminology or IG artifact sorting topics.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already satisfies the issue, including the SHOULD for case-insensitive string sorting and the implementation-dependent treatment of character case and accents.
